title: Remove the unused maestro terminal command and its Settings box
summary: Removed the Mac/Linux-only `maestro` terminal command: its Settings box, install/uninstall backend commands and shell script. Opening a folder passed at start stays.
lessons_learned: A removal story filed by /dev-quick should grep docs/PRDs/ for the feature before recording 'no PRD section': PRD §3.1 still names the removed maestro terminal command
